title.en: Resume a waiting run with If-Match set to the current seq

goal.en: When the device waits for a person, the person confirms by resuming. The resume carries If-Match with the seq read from the status, so two people cannot both answer the same question.

note.en: Start a shakshuka run with a person present.
The arm cuts; the run then waits for a person to heat the pan.
Read the status and keep its seq.
Resume with the seq just read. The hub accepts and the run continues: the person is heating the pan.
One simulated minute of heating passes.
The next step, sautéing the onion, is again one a person performs on this device, so the run waits once more with a higher seq.

cli: jq '. + {"x-hub-human-present": true}' examples/core/execute-request.json | curl -s -X POST http://localhost:7878/v1/executions -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Idempotency-Key: ex-2026-10-04-001-a' -d @-

outcome.en: You have resumed a run with the right precondition. Next: scenario 043 shows what happens with a stale seq.
